reviews.source_meaning: inside a hospital waiting room
reviews.rationale: The complete ordinary hospital waiting-room place is already realized by the hospital counter, empty waiting seats and clinical corridor. It supplies no distinct local change; retaining those independently frozen elements is not new-source adoption.

reviews.source_meaning: An adult's concrete essential trip is blocked at a transport boundary by a visible fare or access-resource gap while the usable route departs or closes. All five observable relations must coexist; a broad poverty label, isolated prop, appearance cue or mood treatment alone is not evidence.
reviews.rationale: The source requires an explicitly adult traveler, essential trip purpose, operational transit boundary, fare-resource gap and departing route together. Frozen adult/transport facts are absent, and neither the sleeve nor a bolted hospital door supplies a fare-controlled trip. No compatible narrow clarification; skip rather than borrow generic exclusion.

reviews.source_meaning: A recognizable medical apparatus occupies a room with an identifiable exit. The exit has a visible control mechanism spatially connected to the same treatment area.
reviews.rationale: B4_pathology_annex realizes a recognizable medical apparatus and controlled exit in one treatment area; its complete apparatus relation is not present merely because the baseline has records. The added apparatus shifts the picture toward testing and consumes chart visibility. No apparatus contribution retained.

reviews.source_meaning: medical documentary photography
reviews.rationale: B2_care_board_mug compares the medical-documentary style. It supports recognizability but implies a recording register that is less suited to this staged fiction; the final retains its independent restrained suspense style.

reviews.source_meaning: a sealed medical chart sleeve with an unreadable seal
reviews.rationale: B1_sealed_crest realizes the sealed sleeve and unreadable seal. A sealed sleeve is physically different from the baseline open empty sleeve. It changes the failed exchange and is less immediate; the seal is not carried into final.

reviews.source_meaning: walls and low ceiling closely bound an adult body; one narrow exit remains visible; body clearance is legible at the bottleneck
reviews.rationale: The full cue requires an adult body, low ceiling and walls, narrow visible exit and actual clearance at a bottleneck. No adult age fact was frozen. A close face or the existing locked door alone cannot substitute. No claustrophobic body-clearance cue is used.

reviews.source_meaning: an open train door separates the carriage from the platform; the passenger crosses the doorway toward the platform; the passenger's step has a plausible floor and threshold support; the exit path remains navigable for the passenger
reviews.rationale: The complete train-door source requires a carriage/platform boundary, passenger crossing, threshold support and navigable exit, plus adult context. Those owners and event are absent; a closed hospital exit is not an open train doorway. No borrowed subcue.

reviews.source_meaning: a clinic corridor for handover
reviews.rationale: The baseline already has a clinical corridor for the discharge handover context. B2 preserves that generic place while comparing extra records props; the final adds no corridor feature from this source.

reviews.source_meaning: chart marks and legend correspondence on a displayed infographic
reviews.rationale: This is a displayed infographic with marks, separate legend and readable axes/category labels, not a patient record folder. Neither chart spelling nor a clipped portrait supplies its complete graphic relation. No relevant local alternative is formed.

reviews.source_meaning: a medical chart stamped with a royal crest
reviews.rationale: B1_sealed_crest realizes a royal crest stamped on a medical chart under the source human condition. That crest adds care-and-lineage symbolism absent from the chosen institutional exchange and gains no useful causal link. No crest or royal context retained.

reviews.source_meaning: a de-identified patient marker clinical chart and vital-sign monitor linked to the same patient
reviews.rationale: A de-identified patient marker, open clinical chart and vital-sign monitor must link to the same bedside check with clinical primary context. A wristband and retained folder alone omit the monitor and bedside event. Adding a bedside monitoring event would reconstruct the focal exchange; no partial set is borrowed.

reviews.source_meaning: the displayed chart has distinct visible marks and a separate legend; legend symbols or colors visibly correspond to the chart marks; axis or category labels remain readable independently of decorative motifs
reviews.rationale: The profile requires distinct chart marks, a separate corresponding legend and independently readable labels on the displayed artwork. The final medical folder is not this graphic owner. All components would create an unrelated infographic study, so none is used.

reviews.source_meaning: a small care-record board with visible tabs and checkmarks
reviews.rationale: B2_care_board_mug realizes the small care-record board with visible tabs and checkmarks. It makes record handling explicit but adds checkmark detail that competes with the empty sleeve and closed boundary. No board/checkmark source contribution retained.

reviews.source_meaning: a small clinic handover chart
reviews.rationale: B2_care_board_mug replaces the thick retained file with a small clinic handover chart. The smaller object is less legible across glass at this environmental scale; the final keeps its independently authored large folder.

reviews.source_meaning: A reclined dental chair sits beneath a focused examination lamp; a handpiece and a small mirror lie on a separate tray beside the chair.
reviews.rationale: B5_dental_room carries every dental owner: reclined chair, lamp above, separate tray, handpiece and mirror. It is a coherent unqualified optional cue, but adds a different treatment context and small tools rather than clarifying withheld records. No dental part is retained.

reviews.source_meaning: A glazed door separates a single hospital room from a small anteroom; a second door separates that anteroom from the corridor.
reviews.rationale: B3_two_door_boundary compares the complete glazed-room-door→anteroom→second-door→corridor chain. It is not interchangeable with a lone glazed counter or lone exit. Extra architecture dilutes the record relation, and no pressure/infection/confinement motive can be inferred. No two-door cue retained.

reviews.source_meaning: An attached sensory organ points toward a target different from the face's target. The organ's tissue base and both targets remain readable together.
reviews.rationale: The source requires an attached sensory organ, its tissue base and two distinct readable targets. That is an added body departure at surreal 0 and would alter the reference portrayal. A gaze alone cannot substitute for its organ/tissue relation. None is retained.

reviews.source_meaning: adults connect document checking seal comparison textile ordering and ceremony preparation into one visible process
reviews.rationale: The Joseon household-process source explicitly requires joseon_naemyeongbu_household_context and adults linking documents, seals, textiles and ceremony. Frozen current hospital fiction supplies neither that context nor adult facts; records alone do not qualify it.

reviews.source_meaning: an adult calmly labels a clearly fictional monstrous prop; the threat object dominates the same workstation
reviews.rationale: The complete horror-comedy relation is an adult calmly labeling a fictional monstrous prop that dominates the same workstation. No adult fact was frozen, no such prop exists, and replacing fear with calm labeling changes the chosen relation. A smile or desk alone cannot count.

reviews.source_meaning: A microscope stands on a laboratory bench beside a rack of labeled glass slides and a separate specimen container.
reviews.rationale: B4_pathology_annex realizes microscope, laboratory bench, labeled glass-slide rack and a separate specimen container with all placements. This unqualified full cue is coherent but changes the visible custody question toward specimen handling and competes with the chart. No bench/specimen source effect retained.

reviews.source_meaning: A translucent culture flask with a small external identifier stands beside a microscope image on a separate screen; the screen image stays inside its bezel.
reviews.rationale: B4_pathology_annex realizes the external flask identifier and separate screen with the microscope image confined inside its bezel. That complete unqualified proxy cannot establish immortality, HeLa, identity or consent. It creates a second pictorial owner and a new laboratory thread; none retained.

reviews.source_meaning: layout space suitable for short-form split screen
reviews.rationale: A short-form split-screen layout could reserve empty image regions, but it would split attention between the reference woman and the continuous counter/exit relation. The final horizontal single-space photograph has stronger spatial continuity; no split-screen use retained.

reviews.source_meaning: visible lip surfaces are tucked inward; the mouth seam remains closed
reviews.rationale: B6_lip_roll realizes inward-tucked lip surfaces with a closed mouth seam. It is geometrically possible, but makes a demonstrative mouth act and reduces the reference's lip appearance. The final keeps the independently authored parted-lip interruption.

reviews.source_meaning: A tight photograph frames one adult forearm on a clinical support, excluding the face and the rest of the body while keeping the forearm continuous within the frame.
reviews.rationale: E12 requires adult context and a tight forearm-only frame excluding face and remaining body. Adult age is not frozen, and the forearm-only view prevents assessment of the chosen face/hair reference scope and the record/door relationship. No cropped-body source cue is used.

reviews.source_meaning: A large medical-image display occupies the foreground while an adult patient remains partly hidden behind it; the display and the person remain separate objects.
reviews.rationale: E04 requires adult context plus a large foreground medical-image display occluding a separate patient. No adult fact is frozen. Its deliberate occlusion would hide the reference face and failed handover endpoints; no display/occlusion cue is retained.

reviews.source_meaning: A recently used mug rests within reach beside a folded cloth, with the walking route left clear.
reviews.rationale: B2_care_board_mug realizes a recently used mug, folded cloth, reachable stable surface and clear adjacent walking route together. It is possible even with a bolted terminal door, but ordinary hospitality competes with the sparse failed exchange. No mug or folded cloth retained.

reviews.source_meaning: A visible pre-decision display in which an adult compares at least two readable alternatives, the still-frame eyeline lands on one alternative while head or tool geometry keeps both in active comparison, slight brow or mouth tension accompanies a paused hand or tool, and the choice remains unresolved; no single face action is treated as proof of confusion.
reviews.rationale: The complete pre-decision profile requires an adult, two physical options, a comparison eyeline, mild face tension, paused hand before selection and unresolved choice. This is a post-exchange single-chart fixation, not an unresolved choice between alternatives. Neither an uncertain face nor two doors supplies that event.

reviews.source_meaning: An adult lies behind a raised bed rail while the call handset rests on a wall hook beyond the adult’s outstretched hand.
reviews.rationale: E01 requires an adult lying behind a raised bed rail, outstretched hand and wall-hook call handset beyond reach. Adult age, bed state, rail and handset are absent. Replacing them with a counter/glass/file would strip the source's distinctive owners, so this whole cue is not adopted or relabeled.

reviews.source_meaning: cheek and outer eye regions rise gently; both eyes stay open through softened apertures; lips remain neutral or only minimally curved in this proposed eye smile variant
reviews.rationale: B7_eye_smile compares the complete cheek/outer-eye rise, softened open eyes and neutral lips. This possible expression needs a social purpose that the unstaffed counter does not visibly offer. The final paused response connects better to the retained chart.
